communities.name: Mbembe villages of Obubra
communities.note: Which of Obubra's villages are Mbembe-speaking is not checked.

history.text: Obubra, from Ubibira, its main village on the Cross River, has 98 villages; many of its communities, its article says, grew from settlements founded during wars between communities.

reviewNotes: Agoi, Isobo and other Obubra peoples are not yet mapped separately.
name: Mbembe (Cross River)

summary.text: The Mbembe of Cross River State live predominantly in Obubra LGA. They are distinct from the Tigon Mbembe of Taraba.

areas.note: 'Mbembe are predominantly found in Obubra LGA.'
